roll_call_vote.vote_question_text: On Cloture on the Motion to Proceed H.R. 3633
roll_call_vote.vote_document_text: To provide for a system of regulation of the offer and sale of digital commodities by the Securities and Exchange Commission and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, to amend the Federal Reserve Act to prohibit the Federal reserve banks from offering certain products or services directly to an individual, to prohibit the use of central bank digital currency for monetary policy, and for other purposes.
roll_call_vote.vote_result_text: Cloture on the Motion to Proceed Rejected (49-50, 3/5 majority required)
